implementation_summary: AnalysisInput gains optional robots and pathLimits, forwarded to checkLinks only when set. LinkPathLimits type re-exported from the analysis barrel. New test shows a robots-disallowed link triggers no fetch and no finding through analyseSite.
risks: robots.isAllowed is called with pathname+search of the link, per broken-links.ts; the policy passed must accept that form (RobotsPolicy.isAllowed does).
handoff: BE-192: in pipeline.ts, set on the analyseSite input: robots = the same RobotsPolicy the Spider used (the crawl's policy object, or whatever exposes isAllowed(pathAndQuery)), and pathLimits = { includePaths: limits.includePaths, excludePaths: limits.excludePaths, startPath: <the crawl start path, same value as input.startPath> }. Leave both unset only when the crawl had no robots policy or limits. LinkPathLimits is exported from audit/analysis/index.ts.
